bias.en: Bearish, improving · slipped under the 10-day, SAR $37.6 holds
bias.zh: 偏空、有所改善 · 跌破 10 日均线，SAR $37.6 守住

read.en: MP fell 3.1% on Nov 2 to $38.35 (range $38.13–40.87) after a 5.0% drop on Oct 30. It is below the rising 5-day ($40.30) and the falling 10-day ($39.44), 30-day ($43.50), 100-day ($49.64) and 200-day ($55.07). MACD has been above its signal since Oct 28, below zero, histogram shrinking; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 28 ($37.61), and RSI is 37.
read.zh: MP 11月2日下跌 3.1%，收于 $38.35（区间 $38.13–40.87），此前 10月30日已下跌 5.0%。股价位于上行的 5 日均线（$40.30）以及下行的 10 日（$39.44）、30 日（$43.50）、100 日（$49.64）和 200 日均线（$55.07）下方。MACD 自 10月28日起位于信号线上方，仍在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月28日起看多（$37.61），RSI 为 37。

read.en: The close broke the $38.5–39.5 support (10-day, Oct 30 low), now resistance, though the SAR held. Resistance is $39.4–39.6 (10-day, Oct 30 close), then $40.3–40.9 (5-day, Nov 2 high) and $41.6–42.5 (Oct 29 close and highs). Support is $37.6–38.1 (SAR, Jul 29 and Nov 2 lows), then $37.1 (52-week low). A close above $40.9 would target $41.6–42.5; below $37.6, $37.1 and a SAR flip.
read.zh: 收盘跌破 $38.5–39.5 支撑（10 日均线、10月30日低点），该区域转为阻力，但 SAR 守住。阻力为 $39.4–39.6（10 日均线、10月30日收盘），其次 $40.3–40.9（5 日均线、11月2日高点）和 $41.6–42.5（10月29日收盘及高点）。支撑为 $37.6–38.1（SAR、7月29日和11月2日低点），其次 $37.1（52 周低点）。若收盘站上 $40.9，下一目标看 $41.6–42.5；若跌破 $37.6，则看 $37.1，SAR 将翻空。

r.en: Oct 29 close $41.64; Oct 16 and Oct 29 highs ($42.51–42.54)

s.en: Parabolic SAR $37.61; Jul 29 low $37.81; Nov 2 low $38.13
